Agent: review-bot. A Claude Code project that reviews pull requests in our monorepo.

CLAUDE.md (excerpt):
  12  ## Review rules
  13  - Comment only on correctness and security. No style nits.
  14  - Use the pr-review skill for every review.

.claude/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md (excerpt):
   8  Read the diff. For each finding, post one comment with file, line, severity (blocker|major|minor), and a fix.
  21  End with a summary: approve / request changes.

.github/workflows/review.yml (excerpt):
  15  - run: claude -p "/pr-review ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"

How it improves today: when authors complain about a bad comment, I edit CLAUDE.md or the skill.
GitHub records whether each review comment was resolved or dismissed, and whether the PR merged,
but nothing reads that data. No eval set. No record of which edits helped.
